hook: The country with the most time zones isn't Russia.

beats.narration: The country with the most time zones isn't Russia.
Russia has eleven. So does the United States.
beats.claim: Russia and the USA each have 11 time zones.
France has 12 time zones, the most of any country.

beats.narration: Mainland France uses just one. The other eleven come from its overseas territories.
beats.claim: Metropolitan France spans 1 time zone; the other 11 come from its dependencies.

beats.narration: From French Polynesia in the Pacific to Reunion in the Indian Ocean.
Count France's claim in Antarctica, and it's thirteen.
beats.claim: Including its Antarctic claim, France has 13 time zones.

beats.narration: So when it's midnight in Paris, it's lunchtime in Tahiti.
beats.claim: Paris is UTC+1 in winter and Tahiti is UTC-10, an 11-hour gap (12 in summer); midnight in Paris is 13:00 (or 12:00) the previous day in Tahiti.

title: The country with the most time zones isn't Russia
description: France spans 12 time zones, more than Russia or the USA, thanks to territories in every ocean.
